Hi, 

When I put my sliderInput inside a renderUI, the numbers denoting the limits do not appear to update appropriately with sliding under certain circumstances.  In the below code, slider2 only updates with sliding when the slider1 line is un-commented:

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$myUI <- renderUI({
    sliderInput("slider2", label = "slider2", min=1, max=10, value=c(1,10))
  })
})

shinyUI(fluidPage(
 # sliderInput("slider1", label = "slider1", min=1, max=10, value=c(1,10)),
  uiOutput('myUI')
))
  
Is there a way to make slider2 slide correctly without showing slider1?

running shiny 0.10.0
Thanks
